messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

It was going to hit overnight, and while the total accumulation being predicted was only a couple of inches, I started doing my snow dance-in my head at least-as soon as I heard the words `` the next storm. ''

output.original_text: It was going to hit overnight, and while the total accumulation being predicted was only a couple of inches, I started doing my snow dance-in my head at least-as soon as I heard the words `` the next storm. ''
output.joy: It was going to hit overnight, and even though they predicted only a couple of inches, I couldn't help but start my joyful snow dance—in my head, of course—at the mention of `` the next storm. ''
output.sadness: It was going to hit overnight, and sadly, the total accumulation predicted was only a couple of inches, but I still started doing my silent snow dance—in my head at least—when I heard the words `` the next storm. ''
output.fear: It was going to hit overnight, and the total accumulation being predicted was only a couple of inches, yet I felt a chill as I began my anxious snow dance—in my head at least—when I heard the words `` the next storm. ''
output.anger: It was going to hit overnight, and the total accumulation they were predicting was just a couple of inches, but the moment I heard the words `` the next storm, '' I couldn't help but internally fume, starting my snow dance—in my head, at least!
output.surprise: It was going to hit overnight, and while the total accumulation was only a couple of inches, I was surprised enough to start doing my snow dance—in my head at least—when I heard the words `` the next storm. ''
output.disgust: It was going to hit overnight, and even though the total accumulation being predicted was only a couple of inches, I felt a wave of disgust as I mentally started my snow dance when I heard the words `` the next storm. ''
